_comment: Oracle AI Database@AWS Exadata shape catalogue. Single source of truth for the
shape, database_server_type and storage_server_type dropdowns on the AWS page.
Edit this file, or use /regions, to add a shape or a server type — no code
change needed. A bad edit is rejected on save, so the file on disk is never
left in a state that would empty the dropdowns.
label                  Human name shown in the dropdown.
status                 live | planned. Planned shapes are shown greyed out.
storage_server_types   Values offered for storage_server_type. HC = High
server_types_required  AWS documents both server types as mandatory for
Exadata.X11M. The card marks them required and
AWS recommends the ListDbSystemShapes API for the authoritative list of server
models available in a given region.
